user.description: Installs the SmartWings quirk for WM25/L-Z shades paired with Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA), keeps it up to date, and tells you when ZHA has not loaded it. Set each shade's limits with its remote: the shade stops at them for Home Assistant too.

abort.zha_not_configured: Set up the Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA) integration first.

zha_not_ready.message: Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA) is not running yet.

quirk_not_loaded.title: SmartWings quirk not loaded
quirk_not_loaded.description:
ZHA did not load the SmartWings quirk for these shades:

{shades}

Without it, ZHA uses the quirk that comes with Home Assistant, which swaps the Open and Close commands for these shades and lacks the SmartWings fixes.

To fix this, install the SmartWings quirk in the folder set as ZHA's `custom_quirks_path`, then restart Home Assistant.

custom_quirks_path_missing.title: Set ZHA's custom_quirks_path for the SmartWings quirk
custom_quirks_path_missing.description:
Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA) loads the SmartWings quirk only from the folder set as its `custom_quirks_path`, and none is set, so ZHA uses the quirk that comes with Home Assistant instead. Add the line to the `zha:` section of `configuration.yaml`, adding the `zha:` line too if there is none:

```yaml
zha:
  custom_quirks_path: {path}
```

Then restart Home Assistant. SmartWings keeps its quirk file in that folder up to date.

restart_required.title: Restart to load the SmartWings quirk
restart_required.description: SmartWings installed the current SmartWings quirk as {file}. Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA) loads quirks only when it starts, so it uses this file only after you restart Home Assistant, or reload ZHA (Settings → Devices & services → Zigbee Home Automation → ⋮ → Reload). Until then ZHA keeps the quirk it started with.

quirk_file_conflict.title: SmartWings quirk file is in the way
quirk_file_conflict.description:
{file} was not installed by SmartWings: its first line is not

`{marker}`

So SmartWings leaves it alone, and Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA) did not load the SmartWings quirk from it. To let SmartWings install and update the quirk, delete that file or move it out of the folder, then restart Home Assistant or reload ZHA. SmartWings then installs its own copy and asks for one more restart.

quirk_file_not_written.title: SmartWings could not update its quirk file
quirk_file_not_written.description:
SmartWings could not write or read {file}: {error}

ZHA cannot load the SmartWings quirk until the file is there. Check that Home Assistant can write to that folder, then restart Home Assistant. You can also copy `quirk/zhaquirks/smartwings/wm25lz.py` from the SmartWings repository there by hand. The integration leaves a copy you made alone, so you must update it yourself.

quirk_now_upstream.title: The SmartWings quirk is now part of Home Assistant
quirk_now_upstream.description: The Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA) quirks that come with Home Assistant now include the SmartWings quirk, so SmartWings no longer updates its own copy, {file}. You may delete that file, then restart Home Assistant so ZHA uses the built-in quirk. If nothing else uses ZHA's `custom_quirks_path` folder, you can also remove the `custom_quirks_path` line from `configuration.yaml`.
